name: Rapid Mixing in Markov Chains
description: Basics of finite Markov chains; classical Markov chains including coupon collection, gambler’s ruin, Polya’s urn, birth and death chains; total variation distance; the convergence theorem; mixing time; bounding mixing time via couplings; bounding mixing time via strong stationary times; random walks on networks; bounding mixing time via hitting times; cover times; spectral bounds on mixing time; mixing time bounds via comparison between chains.
